sentences.en: about how the past may be shaping your behavior today
sentences.zh: 关于过去如何影响你今天的行为，

sentences.en: or a question or comment about this episode,
sentences.zh: 或者对本集有任何问题或评论，

sentences.zh: 请找一个非常安静的房间，

sentences.en: and record a voice memo on your phone.
sentences.zh: 并在手机上录制一段语音备忘录。
